entities.description: A full-body portrait of a standing African man wearing traditional red and blue striped clothing, adorned with multiple beaded necklaces and a feathered headdress. He has a serious expression, is barefoot, and stands on dry, sandy ground with sparse vegetation in the background.

attributes.background: dry, arid landscape with sparse trees and sandy ground

entities.description: A man with dark skin and a shaved head stands facing forward, wearing a red and purple striped wrap dress secured with a bright blue sash. He is adorned with multiple strands of white and blue beaded necklaces, silver bracelets on both wrists, and a single white and black feather headdress on top of his head.

attributes.headwear: single white and black feather headdress

clothing.dress: red and purple horizontal striped wrap
clothing.sash: bright blue fabric tied at the waist

accessories.necklaces: multiple strands of white and blue beads

entities.description: A full-body portrait of a standing man with dark skin, wearing a sleeveless, knee-length garment with horizontal red and purple stripes, cinched at the waist with a bright blue sash. He is adorned with multiple layers of beaded necklaces in red, white, and blue, a single feather in his hair, and a metal bracelet on his left wrist, standing barefoot on dry, sandy ground.

clothing.garment: sleeveless, knee-length, red and purple horizontal stripes

accessories.necklaces: multiple layers, red, white, and blue beads

attributes.background: dry, sandy ground with sparse vegetation, hazy sky
